concerns.text: Phase 7 (T038-T042) introduces tasks for pole figure validation, dislocation density proxies, and lattice symmetry constraints. These tasks have no corresponding FR/SC in spec.md and contradict the plan.md which explicitly removed these as 'unapproved' scope creep. This represents a complete lack of coverage for these tasks against the current spec/plan, and conversely, the spec/plan has no coverage for these implemented tasks.

FR-001 (Data Acquisition) and US-1 Scenario 3 (Error Handling for missing levels) lack complete task coverage. T011 is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and T013 (Error handling) is unchecked. Without these, the system cannot satisfy the requirement to download data or handle missing reduction levels gracefully as mandated by the spec.

FR-002 (Symmetry Re-indexing) and FR-008 (Material Type as categorical) lack complete task coverage. T020 (Integrate orix symmetry) is unchecked, and T026 (Include Material Type) is unchecked. T018 and T025 are marked complete, but they cannot satisfy the spec requirements without the symmetry handling and categorical feature implementation defined in the unchecked tasks.

SC-004 (Sensitivity Analysis stability) requires verification of R² variation ≤ 0.02. T031 (Unit test for sensitivity analysis) is listed as 'rejected' in the notes but appears in the task list as an unaddressed item. There is no task covering the unit testing of the sensitivity analysis logic required to prove SC-004.

T030 is tagged as '[DEPRECATED - Merged into T029]' but remains in the task list. This is a stale tag referencing a task that no longer exists as a distinct entity, creating confusion in the task list.
